answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The tundra lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the raven is where a second reviewer recomputes them. What survives to the reef is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
